newsitem.title: USA: Mednet MPC finalizes deal, sees 97 revs up.
newsitem.headline: Mednet MPC finalizes deal, sees 97 revs up.

text.p: Mednet MPC Corp said Wednesday it finalized an agreement with Zenith Administrators Inc for a contract that will increase revenues in 1997 by $50 million and be accretive to earnings.

Mednet said in a release that the contract opens its market potential to an additional 230,000 lives, and to a $50 million existing prescription drug management business, with the potential for a total of two million lives during the next three years.

The agreement calls for the Union Labor Life Insurance Co and Zenith Administrators, both subsidiaries within the ULLICO Inc holding group, to utilize Mednet's integrated retail and mail service prescription drug management services.
Mednet said the companies will use the services for marketing to potential and existing clients with an additional goal of increasing the number of prescription drug benefit clients.
